_why: redash (Flask backend + React/JSX frontend, ~209 py files). Seamcheck emitted 19 claims: 15 css_selector unused, 3 env_var unused, 1 redis_key unresolved. All 19 were judged by opening the flagged file and grepping every reference form across the repo (JSX/TSX className, Jinja templates, shell scripts, compose, CLI). 7 TRUE, 12 FALSE. Dominant miss: JSX/TSX className attributes are not scanned as class usage (8 of 12 false claims).

redis_key:data_sources:schema:blacklist.why: Only reference in the whole repo is the smembers read at redash/tasks/queries/maintenance.py:197; no SADD/writer in py, cli, bin, or docs. It is an ops knob written manually via redis-cli, but in-repo the claim 'read here, written nowhere' is accurate.

env_var:POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD.why: Set on the compose 'postgres' service running the third-party image postgres:18-alpine (compose.yaml:65); it is consumed by that image's official entrypoint. Env on a third-party-image service is externally consumed by design, not left over.

env_var:PYTHONUNBUFFERED.why: Well-known CPython interpreter env var (compose.yaml:36,51) — consumed by the Python runtime the app services run under, never by app code. A universally-known interpreter/runtime var should never be claimed unused.

env_var:REDASH_GUNICORN_TIMEOUT.why: Read IN-REPO at bin/docker-entrypoint:48 as ${REDASH_GUNICORN_TIMEOUT:-60} — an extensionless shell script with default-expansion syntax the scanner did not scan.

css_selector:class:logo-container.why: No element anywhere (JSX, TSX, Jinja templates, HTML) carries this class; login.css is only CopyPlugin'd to styles/login.css by webpack.config.js:128 and nothing links it. Dead leftover from an old login page.

css_selector:class:content-container.why: No element in any markup form carries this class; same orphaned login.css as logo-container.

css_selector:class:schedule.why: Used as a React component prop: className="schedule" on the antd Modal at client/app/components/queries/ScheduleDialog.jsx:196. JSX className not scanned.
